title: jmap-client: implement JmapClient (client.rs)
description: Implement crate-jmap-client/src/client.rs: JmapClient struct with new(), fetch_session(), call(), upload_blob(), download_blob(), subscribe_events(). Generalized from JmapChatClient. Includes three mandatory changes beyond generalization: extract_response must be pub, response body size caps must be added (HIGH security), and Session URL fields must be scheme-validated.
design: Rename JmapChatClient -> JmapClient. Remove all Chat-specific methods. Keep only five base methods. CHANGE 1 — extract_response visibility: promote from pub(crate) to pub so that jmap-chat-client and jmap-mail-client extension crates can use it. CHANGE 2 — response body size caps (HIGH security): fetch_session, call, and download_blob must enforce a maximum response body size before deserializing. Use reqwest's .take(N) on the response byte stream or check content-length header before reading. Suggested limit: 64 MiB for download_blob, 8 MiB for call, 1 MiB for fetch_session. Add a ResponseTooLarge variant to ClientError. CHANGE 3 — Session URL scheme validation: after deserializing the Session document, validate that apiUrl, uploadUrl, downloadUrl, and eventSourceUrl all use https:// (or http:// for local/test environments — emit a warning via eprintln\! but do not error). URL validation logic (scheme check, path check, query/fragment check) for new() copies verbatim from jmapchat-client.
